name: DeepSeek
summary: A Chinese lab publishing open-weight models with strong reasoning at markedly lower cost than the large Western hosted services, usable via its own API or self-hosted.
freeTierNotes: Web chat is free to use; API is paid but priced well below the major Western providers. Weights are downloadable for self-hosting.
tosNotes: Check the current terms and, for organisational use, where data is processed — this differs from Western providers and matters for some compliance regimes.
